Install ONNX Runtime

Source: R/runtime.R
laya_install_runtime.Rd

layaR runs models on ONNX Runtime, which it loads when the first engine is created rather than building it in. On first use layaR downloads Microsoft's official build (version 1.28.0, MIT license) from its NuGet package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime (about 139 MB, checked against the SHA-512 that nuget.org publishes) and keeps only this platform's library (about 25 MB) in tools::R_user_dir("layaR", "data"). laya_download_model() does this for you; call laya_install_runtime() to do it on its own, for example before going offline.

Usage

laya_install_runtime(overwrite = FALSE, ask = interactive())

laya_runtime_info()

Arguments

overwrite

Download again even if the library is installed?

ask

Ask for confirmation before downloading? Defaults to TRUE in interactive sessions.

Value

laya_install_runtime() returns the library's path, invisibly. laya_runtime_info() returns a list: the version layaR installs, the path and source ("option", "ORT_DYLIB_PATH" or "layaR") of the library it would load, whether layaR's own copy is installed, whether a library is loaded, and, once loaded, its loaded_path, loaded_version and ONNX Runtime's build_info.

Details

Microsoft publishes builds for Linux (x86_64 and arm64), macOS on Apple silicon and Windows (x64). Elsewhere, Intel Macs included, install ONNX Runtime 1.27 or newer yourself and point layaR at the library with options(layaR.onnxruntime = "/path/to/libonnxruntime.dylib") or the ORT_DYLIB_PATH environment variable. Either one also overrides the downloaded library on supported platforms.

The library is loaded once per R session. To switch to another one, restart R.

See also

laya_download_model()

Examples

laya_runtime_info()
#> $version
#> [1] "1.28.0"
#> 
#> $path
#> [1] "/home/runner/.local/share/R/layaR/onnxruntime/1.28.0/libonnxruntime.so"
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $installed
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $loaded
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $loaded_path
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $loaded_version
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $build_info
#> [1] NA
#> 
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
laya_install_runtime()
} # }
